senses.gloss: स्रवद्गर्भा स्रवद्गर्भा, i. e. स्रवन्त्-गर्भ (vb. स्रु), f. a woman or cow miscarrying by accident.
स्रव- + द्रङ्ग स्रव- + द्रङ्ग, m. a fair, a market.
स्रस्तोत्तर- + पट स्रस्तोत्तर- + पट, i. e. स्रस्त-उत्तर- (vb. स्रंस्), adj. with the upper garment loose.
† श्रङ्क् श्रङ्क्, स्रङ्क् स्रङ्क्, श्लङ्क् श्रङ्क्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.
स्रङ्क् स्रङ्क्, see श्रङ्क्.
† श्रङ्ग् श्रङ्ग्, श्लङ्ग् श्लङ्ग्, श्वङ्ग् श्वङ्ग्, स्वङ्ग् स्वङ्ग्, i. 1, Par. To go.

श्रण् श्रण्, i. 1 and 10, Par. To give, to present.
 --With the prep. वि वि, i. 10, To distribute, to give, Ragh. 14, 15. विश्राणित, Given away, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 2.

श्रत् श्रत्, perhaps properly श्रथ्, a prefix combined and compounded with धा, and in the Vedas with कृ, and their derivatives, and implying faith.
 --Cf. Lat. cred in credo, for cred-do; see धा, p. 437.

श्रथ् श्रथ्, i. 1 and 10, Par., and श्रन्थ् ii. 9, श्रथ्ना, नी, and i. 1 and 10, Par.
 1. To tie (ved. ii. 9).
 2. To untie, to loosen (ved. ii. 9).
 3. † To kill. श्रन्थ्, i. 1, Ātm. To be loose. श्रथ्, i. 10, Par.
 I. † श्राथय,
 1. To apply diligently.
 2. To delight frequently.
 II. श्रथय, † To be loose.
 --Cf. κλώθω, κάλαθος; Lat. crates, rete, restis; Goth. af-hlathan; O.H.G. and A.S. hládan; O.H.G. hlast; A.S. hlaest.

श्रथन श्रथ् + अन, n.
 1. Tieing.
 2. Untieing.
श्रद्दधानता श्रद्दधान + ता (ptcple. pres. of श्रत्-धा), f. Faith, Man. 7, 86.

श्रद्ध श्रद्ध, i. e. श्रत्-धा, n., and f. धा.
 1. Faith, Man. 3, 202 (f.); Bhag. 6, 37 (f.).
 2. Trust, intimacy, Rājat. 5, 285.
 3. Respect, reverence, Pañc. 265, 15 (f.).
 4. Purity.
 5. Wish, hope, Bhartṛ. 1, 89.
 --Comp.

श्राद्ध श्राद्ध, i. e. श्रद्धा + अ,
 I. adj. Faithful.
 II. n.
 I. A funeral ceremony and worship of the Manes, consisting of offerings to the gods and Manes, and gifts and food to the relations and assisting Brāhmaṇas, Man. 1, 112; 3, 81; 82; 204; Pañc. ii. d. 101.
 2. Gifts given at the श्राद्ध, Lass. 89, 1.
 --Comp.
श्रद्धामय श्रद्धा + मय, adj., f. यी, Full of faith, Bhag. 17, 3.

श्रद्धालु श्रद्धा + लु,
 I. adj.
 1. Faithful.
 2. Wishing, desirous.
 II. f. A pregnant woman longing for anything.
श्रद्धावन्त् श्रद्धा + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Believing, having faith, Bhag. 3, 31.
श्रद्धेयत्व श्रद्धेय + त्व (ptcple. of the fut. pass. of श्रत्-धा), n. Trustworthiness, Pañc. 162, 2.
श्रन्थ् श्रन्थ्, see श्रथ्.

श्रन्थ श्रन्थ् + अ, m.
 1. Tieing.
 2. Untieing.
 3. Viṣṇu.

श्रन्थन श्रन्थ् + अन, n.
 1. Tieing.
 2. Stringing flowers.
 3. Loosening.
 4. Killing.

श्रम् श्रम्, i. 4, श्राम्य, Par.
 1. To exert one's self, Lass. 2. ed. 66, 18.
 2. To perform acts of religious austerity, to undergo mortification or penance.
 3. To be wearied, Megh. 97.
 4. † To be distressed.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. श्रान्त.
 1. Wearied, fatigued, tired, Vikr. 67, 2.
 2. Calmed. m. An ascetic.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. परि परि, परिश्रान्त,
 1. Having performed acts of religious austerity, MBh. 3, 10002.
 2. Fatigued, Man. 4, 99.
 3. Exhausted, MBh. 1, 7626.
 4. Overcome with distress, Mālat. 154, 10.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To repose, Hit. iv. d. 67; Rām. 1, 62, 1.
 2. To go to rest, Vikr. 40, 2.
 3. To cease, Pañc. 220, 25 (with ptcple. in the signification of an infin.). विश्रान्त,
 1. Reposed, Hit. 77, 1; reposing, Pañc. 222, 1; having reposed, Hit. 99, 5.
 2. Ceased, Vikr. d. 130; desisting from.
 3. Calm, composed, Utt. Rāmac. 3, 1.
 --Caus. श्रमय (and in epic poetry श्रामय), To let repose, MBh. 3, 11004.
 --Cf. perhaps A.S. hearm, grief, and O.H.G. râmen, râmjan, intendere.
श्राम् श्राम्, v. r. of ग्राम्.

श्रम श्रम् + अ, m.
 1. Exertion, Pañc. 226, 25; labour, toil, Pañc. 134, 14; taking pains, Chr. 22, 20; [] with कृ, to study, Man. 2, 168.
 2. Military exercise.
 3. Fatigue, weariness, Hiḍ. 1, 19; Kir. 5, 28; Utt. Rāmac. 158, 10 (-अम्बु, Perspiration).
 --Comp.

श्राम श्राम, i. e. श्रम् + अ, m.
 1. A temporary shed.
 2. Time.
 3. A month.

श्रमण श्रमण, i. e. श्रम् + अन,
 I. adj.
 1. Following a low business.
 2. Base.
 II. m.
 1. An ascetic, a Bauddha friar, Rājat. 5, 427.
 2. A religious mendicant, Rām. 1, 13, 13.
 III. f. णा.
 1. A female mendicant; also णी, Rām. 2, 38, 5.
 2. A woman of low caste or business.
 3. A handsome woman.
श्रमणाय श्रमणाय, a denomin. derived from the last with य, Ātm. To become a beggar, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 787.

श्रमिन् श्रम् + इन्, and श्रम + इन्, adj.
 1. Laborious, diligent.
 2. Wearying.

श्रम्भ् श्रम्भ्, स्रम्भ् स्रम्भ्, i. 1, Ātm. † To be careless.
 --With the prep. वि वि, To entrust, to confide.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. विश्रब्ध.
 1. Confided, entrusted, MBh. 3, 2161.
 2. Confided in.
 3. Confident, fearless, Pañc. 75, 9.
 4. Firm, Chr. 32, 30.
 5. Tranquil, patient.
 6. Lowlyminded. Acc. ˚धम्, adv.
 1. Without hesitation, Man. 8, 417.
 2. Without fear, Rām. 3, 49, 33.
 3. Quietly, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 6.
स्रम्भ् स्रम्भ्, see श्रम्भ्.
श्रयण श्रयण, i. e. श्रि + अन, n. Refuge, protection.

श्रव श्रव, m., i. e.
 1. श्रु + अ, The ear.
 2. (Wrongly for स्रव), Oozing, dripping.
 --Comp.

स्रव स्रव, i. e. स्रु + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Oozing, trickling, flowing, Lass. 2. ed. 59, 5.
 2. A drop, Hiḍ. 2, 9.
 3. A fountain.
 II. f. वा, A plant, Sanseviera zeylanica.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ῥόος.

स्राव स्राव, i. e. स्रु + अ, m. Oozing, flowing.
 --Comp.

श्रवण श्रवण, i. e. श्रु + अन,
 I. m. and n. The ear, Hit. i. d. 193, M.M.
 II. m., and f. णा, The twenty-third lunar asterism.
 III. n.
 1. Hearing, Pañc. 188, 10.
 2. Study, Vedāntas. in Chr. 216, 2; learning, Mālat. 6, 5.
 --Comp.

श्रावण श्रावण, i. e.
 A. श्रवण + अ,
 I. adj. Born or produced under the asterism श्रवना̆.
 II. m. The name of a month (July--August).
 III. f. णी.
 1. The day of full moon in the month Śrāvaṇa, Man. 4, 95.
 2. The name of one of the domestic sacrifices (पाक-यज्ञ), Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 527.
 B. श्रु, Caus., + अन, n. Causing to hear.
 --Comp.

स्रवण स्रवण, i. e. स्रु + अन, n.
 1. Oozing, flowing.
 2. Sweat.
 3. Urine.

श्रवस् श्रवस्, i. e. श्रु + अस्, n.
 1. The ear.
 2. Renown, wealth, Chr. 294, 8 = Rigv. i. 92, 8.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. κλέος.
श्रवस्यु श्रवस् + यु, adj. Desirous of renown or wealth, Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 85, 8.
श्रवाय्य श्रवाय्य, m. An animal destined for sacrifice.
श्रविष्ठा श्रविष्ठा (f. of a superl. based on श्रवस्, in the signification ‘wealth’), f. A lunar asterism (= धनिष्ठा).

श्रा श्रा, † ii. 2, Par., श्रै श्रै [] († स्रै स्रै, † शै शै), † i. 1, श्राय, Par.
 1. To boil, to cook, to mature, to ripen.
 2. † To sweat; cf. श्री.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. श्राण.
 1. Boiled, dressed.
 2. Moist, wet. f. णा, Rice-gruel.
 II. श्रित, Cooked, ved. and Rām. 2, 56, 24, Schlegel (but Gorr. 2, 56, 26, शृत).
 III. शृत, Boiled, Man. 11, 147.
 --Caus. श्रपय and † श्रापय, To cook, MBh. 3, 5038.
 --Cf. κρίϐανος, κρίϐανον, κλίϐανος, κριϐάνη, κράμϐος, καρτός, κάρϕω, κάρδοπος, probably κραῦρος, perhaps κέραμος, κέρνον; Lat. cremare, carbo, probably calere, cinis; Goth. hauri, hlaibs; A.S. heordh, hláf, haerefaest, haerfest, Ripe.

श्राद्धिक श्राद्धिक, i. e. श्राद्ध + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to an obsequial offering.
 2. n. A present given at a श्राद्ध, Man. 4, 116.
 II. m., f. कि, n. The object, receiver, or enjoyer of an obsequial oblation.
श्रान्ति श्रान्ति, i. e. श्रम् + ति. f. Weariness.

श्राय श्राय,
 I. श्रि + अ, m. Refuge, [] protection.
 II. श्री + अ, adj. Sacred, or belonging, to the goddess श्री.

श्रावक श्रावक, i. e. श्रु, Caus., + अक, m.
 1. The name of a class of the Bauddha votaries; a lay votary of the Bauddha religion, Pañc. 236, 19.
 2. A pupil, Mālat. 174, 4.
श्रावणिक श्रावणिक, i. e. श्रावण + इक, m. The month श्रावण.
स्रंश् स्रंश्, v. r. of the next.

1. स्रंस् स्रंस्, i. 1, Ātm. To fall [] down. Bhag. 1, 30; to fall asunder, Utt. Rāmac. 77, 15.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. स्रस्त.
 1. Fallen, Daśak. in Chr. 196, 20.
 2. Hanging down, Śāk. d. 29.
 3. Loosened.
 4. Separated.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to fall from, Bhartṛ. 1, 49.
 2. To move, Ragh. 6, 75.
 --Ptcple. pf. pass. स्रंसित, Caused to be loosened, Utt. Rāmac. 40, 12.
 --With the prep. आ आ, आस्रस्त, Fallen off, MBh. 4, 777.
 --With वि वि, विस्रस्त, The same, Arj. 10, 64.
 --Caus. To cause to drop, Mahāvīrac. 73, 17.
2. स्रंस् स्रंस्, v. r. of श्रम्भ्.

स्रंसिन् स्रंस् + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Falling, Mālat. 79, 3; being loosened, Śāk. d. 29.
 2. Hanging down, pendulous.
 II. m. A tree, commonly पीलु.
† स्रंह् स्रंह्, i. 1, Ātm. To confide (cf. श्रम्भ्).
स्रग्विन् स्रग्विन्, i. e. स्रज् + विन्, adj., f. नी, Bearing a chaplet, Man. 2, 167.
स्रज् स्रज्, vb. सृज्, f. A chaplet, a wreath of flowers, a garland, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3322; Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 10.
स्रवन्त स्रवन्त, i. e. स्रवन्त्, ptcple. pres. of स्रु, + अ, adj. Dropping, Pañc. i. d. 346.

स्रष्टृ स्रष्टृ, i. e. सृज् + तृ, m.
 1. A creator, Man. 1, 33; MBh. 7, 2864; Vikr. d. 159.
 2. A maker, author, Rājat. 4, 655.
 3. Brahman.
 4. Śiva.
स्रस्तर स्रस्तर, i. e. probably स्रंस् + तृ + अ, or + त्र, n. A bed, Kāvya Prak. 68, 4 (Prākṛ.).
स्राक् स्राक्, vb. सृ, probably सर-अञ्च्, cf. द्राक्, acc. sing. n., adv. Quickly.
स्रस्त- + हस्त स्रस्त- + हस्त (vb. स्रंस्), adj. relaxing one's hold.
